aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Staff of Detective Pikachu Returns
Category:Detective Pikachu Returns
This is a list of staff members who worked on the game Detective Pikachu Returns for the Nintendo Switch, per the game credits. It was published by Nintendo and The Pokémon Company and developed by Creatures, Inc. All names are given in Western order.
